User_Story: As an admin, I want to create a workspace and invite members with roles so that my team can track time together.
Notes: DynamoDB domain. members[] with role ADMIN/MANAGER/MEMBER.

User_Story: As an admin, I want to create a project with an hourly rate and a budget in hours so that work can be tracked against it.
Notes: DynamoDB domain. GSI1 by workspaceId. status ACTIVE/ARCHIVED.

User_Story: As a manager, I want to list projects in my workspace with cursor pagination so that large workspaces stay fast.
Notes: Cursor pagination via GSI1 (workspaceId). Golden Rule #16 — no offset.

User_Story: As a member, I want to start and stop a timer on a project so that my hours are recorded.
Notes: DynamoDB domain. GSI1 user+startedAt, GSI2 project+startedAt. At most one running timer per user. Actor from @CurrentUser (#23).

User_Story: As a member, I want to view my time entries for a date range so that I can check my week.
Notes: Query GSI1 (user + startedAt range), cursor paginated.

User_Story: As a member, I want to add or edit a time entry manually for a past date so that I can log time I forgot to track with the live timer.
Notes: Manual-entry modal (Add time entry). Still passes IProjectValidator ACL. Both startedAt+stoppedAt set; durationSeconds derived. data-testid: create-timeentry-form.

User_Story: As the system, I want starting a timer to synchronously verify the project is ACTIVE and the user is a workspace member before recording it so that time cannot be logged to invalid projects.
Notes: ACL — apply sync-cross-service-call skill. IProjectValidator validates project status + workspace membership. getOutboundHeaders() (#24). Golden Rule #14.

User_Story: As a member, I want to submit my weekly timesheet so that it goes to my manager for review.
Notes: Sets entries SUBMITTED and publishes TIMESHEET_SUBMITTED with totalHours. Saga step 0.

User_Story: As the system, I want a submitted timesheet to be checked against the project budget asynchronously so that overruns are flagged automatically.
Notes: Saga step 1 — apply choreography-saga skill. project-event-handler aggregates hours vs budgetHours; replies BUDGET_OK | BUDGET_EXCEEDED. Idempotent.

User_Story: As a manager, I want the timesheet to be auto-approved or flagged when the budget check returns so that I only review exceptions.
Notes: Saga step 2. timeentry-event-handler consumes BUDGET_OK/BUDGET_EXCEEDED; timesheet APPROVED | FLAGGED; FLAGGED fans out manager notification. Replay = no-op.

User_Story: As a manager, I want a webapp dashboard of projects with budget-burn badges so that I can spot overruns.
Notes: Thin-orchestrator page + data-table + status-variants.ts. data-testid: projects-table.

User_Story: As a member, I want a webapp timer widget and timesheet view so that I can track and submit time.
Notes: Client hooks in client-common. Form via react-hook-form + Zod from @old-st/contracts/timeentry.

User_Story: As a member, I want a mobile timer so that I can start and stop tracking away from my desk.
Notes: Reuses client-common hooks. Expo screen. Note: + mobile.
